name: A cast of an expanded child after an earlier KEEP reads the converted column through the projection

body.query: FROM ne_keep_a, ne_keep_b | NESTED_EXPAND items | KEEP id, items.qty, items.price | CHANGE_POINT items.qty ON items.qty | EVAL p = TO_LONG(items.price) | KEEP id, p | SORT p | LIMIT 10
